_comment: Rule sets a reviewer has judged COMPLETE, with the reason. The sweep still
measures them and still prints their numbers — it only stops calling them
incomplete, so an exemption cannot hide a later regression, only a known
⚠ An entry here is a CLAIM WITH A DATE AND AN AUTHOR, not a mute. If the
reason stops being true — a language comes into scope, Unicode adds to the
script — delete the entry rather than editing the reason to fit.

cmn-Bopo.reason: COMPLETE for Mandarin: 37/37 zhuyin U+3105-3129 present. The 0/6 at U+312A-312F are Min Nan and Hakka letters — other languages sharing the script. The whole-script percentage (49%) is an artefact of Unicode's repertoire, not a gap.

mya-Mymr.reason: Myanmar Extended-A/B hold Khamti, Shan, Tai Laing, Aiton and Shwe Palaung letters — other languages in the Burmese script, not Burmese. Out of scope for a mya rule set. ⚠ NOT a statement about the primary block, which the run signal still judges.

bho-Deva.reason: Devanagari Extended U+A8E0 is Vedic cantillation, out of scope for toponyms. ⚠ This exempts the BLOCK flag only — bho-Deva is 10/17 on independent vowels and that remains open work.
